record_type_quote: This study shows that the genetic variants near the  LBX1  gene are associated with AIS susceptibility in Chinese Han population. It successfully replicates the results of the GWAS, which was performed in a Japanese population.

targets.authors: Takahashi Y, Kou I, Takahashi A, Johnson TA, Kono K, et al.
targets.title: A genome-wide association study identifies common variants near LBX1 associated with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
targets.evidence_quote: In the case-control study, all three genotyped SNPs were found to be associated with AIS predisposition. We also found G, T, and G to be risk alleles for rs11598564, rs11190870, and rs625039, respectively, the same as those reported in the previous Japanese GWAS  [1] . The association between common variants near  LBX1  and AIS predisposition found in Japanese population was successfully replicated in this Chinese Han population.
targets.outcome_quote: The association between common variants near  LBX1  and AIS predisposition found in Japanese population was successfully replicated in this Chinese Han population.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall successful replication verdict for the three susceptibility variants. The case-only curvature-severity analysis is an extension, not a failed replication of a severity finding in the original.

reasoning: New Southern Chinese Han sample tests three susceptibility SNPs from the named Japanese GWAS. Other Chinese replications and the US GWAS provide contextual corroboration and are not separately designated targets by the study; other gene association studies are background.
